remarks: Wake up to breathtaking waterfront views and experience luxury living at Stamford Landing in this beautifully updated first-floor corner residence. Thoughtfully designed with sophisticated finishes, modern upgrades, and an effortless indoor-outdoor feel, this exceptional 1-bedroom home offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and resort-inspired living.  The expansive kitchen features quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, abundant cabinetry, and a large pantry, perfect for entertaining. The sun-filled living and dining area offers a gas fireplace, brand-new modern ceiling fan, custom window treatments with a motorized privacy shade, and sliders leading to your private balcony overlooking the marina, complete with a charming garden area.  The spa-inspired bathroom features an oversized Jacuzzi tub, custom tilework, recessed lighting, oversized glass mirror vanity, and a luxurious bidet toilet with integrated lighting and filtration. The spacious bedroom features a stylish modern glass-panel sliding door and brand-new ceiling fan.  Additional highlights include freshly painted interiors, in-unit washer and dryer, and garage parking.  Enjoy resort-style amenities including a heated outdoor pool, hot tub, beautifully landscaped grounds, community dog run, and waterfront boardwalk connecting you to Harbor Point's restaurants, bars, shops, parks, and entertainment.
